notes: Three storeys: a raised basement (small windows ~5-6 ft, not a storey), a tall first floor (sills ~8.7 ft), a second floor (sills ~18.7 ft), and a mansard storey with three dormers per long side and three on the west (sills ~30 ft). A one-storey wing (roof ~17 ft) on the east end: south ruler 0.80-1.0, north 0.0-0.2. South: clear, three bays; first-floor centre is a projecting bay window, right is a paired window; nothing above the wing. North: lower half behind cars/shrubs and smeared; the centre of storey 1 (0.45-0.65) is a hooded porch, the door there is a guess from a dark opening; storey-2 triple window at 0.61 is short (sill ~20 ft). West: front entrance porch with door at the left (north) end, two-window bay on storey 1; the strip 0.80-1.0 is smeared. East: badly smeared and partly hidden by a tree; only the wing's storey-1 triple window and a small window are readable; storeys 2 and 3 of the east side left out.
